# ⋆｡°✩❗ KRILL'S DOCUMENT RETEXTURES ❗✩°｡⋆
- The Trinkets in **BOH** replaced the old Document textures, I personally preferred the Documents so I decided to texture my own
- For now, retextures only the *Trinkets* into **Documents** using my texture of the **Haunted Paper** creating a more authentic, cryptic feel when printing things on the Computer
![DOCUMENT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09f1c6aa65aedebbd228f1fdfd391316a1747304.png)
